<?php
class VirtualBackedParent43 {
    public int $value {
        get {
            echo "P:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|";
            return 7;
        }
    }
    public function parentRead() {
        echo "H|";
        return $this->value;
    }
}
class VirtualBackedBridge43 extends VirtualBackedParent43 {
    private function answer() { return 500; }
}
class VirtualBackedChild43 extends VirtualBackedBridge43 {
    public int $value = 200 {
        get {
            echo "C:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|";
            return $this->value + $this->answer();
        }
    }
    private function answer() { return 13; }
}
class VirtualBackedGrand43 extends VirtualBackedChild43 {
    private function answer() { return 900; }
}
$parent = new VirtualBackedParent43;
$child = new VirtualBackedChild43;
$grand = new VirtualBackedGrand43;
echo (array)$parent === [] ? "EMPTY|" : "BAD|";
echo (array)$child === ["value" => 200] ? "C200|" : "BAD|";
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 200] ? "G200|" : "BAD|";
echo $parent->value, "|";
echo $child->value, "|";
echo $grand->parentRead(), "|";
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 200] ? "G200|" : "BAD|";
$grand->value = 300;
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 300] ? "G300|" : "BAD|";
echo $grand->value, "|";

<?php
class VirtualBackedLeaf43 {
    public $tag;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D", $this->tag, "|"; }
}
function virtualBackedFresh43($tag) {
    global $weak_returned;
    echo "G", $tag, "|";
    $leaf = new VirtualBackedLeaf43;
    $leaf->tag = $tag;
    $weak_returned = WeakReference::create($leaf);
    return $leaf;
}
class VirtualBackedLifeParent43 {
    public mixed $value { get => virtualBackedFresh43("P"); }
    public function parentRead() { return $this->value; }
    public function __destruct() {
        $raw = (array)$this;
        $leaf = $raw["value"];
        echo "B", $leaf->tag, "|";
    }
}
class VirtualBackedLifeBridge43 extends VirtualBackedLifeParent43 {}
class VirtualBackedLifeChild43 extends VirtualBackedLifeBridge43 {
    public mixed $value = null {
        get {
            $backing = $this->value;
            echo "C", $backing->tag, "|";
            return virtualBackedFresh43("R");
        }
    }
}
class VirtualBackedLifeGrand43 extends VirtualBackedLifeChild43 {}
$box = new VirtualBackedLifeGrand43;
$weak_box = WeakReference::create($box);
echo ((array)$box === ["value" => null] ? "NULL_SLOT|" : "BAD|");
$stored = new VirtualBackedLeaf43;
$stored->tag = "S";
$weak_stored = WeakReference::create($stored);
$box->value = $stored;
unset($stored);
echo "STORED|";
$kept = $box->parentRead();
echo "H", $kept->tag, "|";
echo ((array)$box === ["value" => $weak_stored->get()] ? "SLOT_S|" : "BAD|");
unset($box);
echo ($weak_box->get() === null ? "BN|" : "BL|");
echo ($weak_stored->get() === null ? "SN|" : "SL|");
echo ($weak_returned->get() === null ? "RN|" : "LIVE|");
unset($kept);
echo ($weak_returned->get() === null ? "RN|" : "LIVE|");
